# budongsan-tax

> Korean real-estate tax engine and MCP server (stdio). 43 tools, 862 statute nodes, official rulings as regression tests. Every result lists the statute articles applied and not applied. Not tax advice.

Repository: https://github.com/taylee9809/budongsan-tax
MCP registry name: io.github.taylee9809/budongsan-tax
License: AGPL-3.0-or-later

## Tools

- search_law: Search Korean statutes and administrative rules on the national law database (law.go.kr). Needs LAW_OC key.
- get_law_detail: Fetch the full text of a Korean statute by name or MST id, optionally one article. Needs LAW_OC key.
- get_local_tax_ordinances: Look up a Korean city/county tax ordinance (rate adjustments, local reliefs). Needs LAW_OC key.
- search_tax_rulings: Search official Korean tax rulings and tribunal decisions used as regression answers.
- calc_transfer_tax: Korea capital gains tax (양도소득세) on real estate: rate, long-term holding deduction, heavy rates, surtax. Returns the statute trail.
- calc_acquisition_tax: Korea acquisition tax (취득세) on real estate plus local education tax and rural special tax, by year and acquisition type.
- calc_property_tax: Korea property tax (재산세) on housing: fair-market ratio, base cap, one-household special rate, urban area levy, education tax.
- calc_jongbu_tax: Korea comprehensive real estate holding tax (종합부동산세) on housing: deductions, progressive rates, property-tax credit, age/holding credits, burden cap.
- calc_rental_income_tax: Compute the 14% separate tax on residential rental income up to 20 million won, with registered-landlord deductions.
- calc_dealer_comparative_tax: Comparative taxation for real estate dealers under Income Tax Act art. 64.
- calc_attached_land_limit: Maximum land area attached to a home covered by the capital gains exemption, by zone (3x/5x/10x).
- calc_gift_tax: Korea gift tax (증여세) on real estate: relationship deductions, marriage/birth deduction, prior gifts, progressive rates.
- calc_inheritance_tax: Korea inheritance tax (상속세): basic, spouse and lump-sum deductions, progressive rates (estate basis).
- estimate_reconstruction_levy: Estimate the reconstruction excess-profit levy (재건축부담금): exemptions, base, rate bands, reductions.
- judge_acquisition_homes_and_rate: Count homes for acquisition tax and decide the rate (1/8/12%), temporary two-home relief, corporate rules.
- judge_transfer_reliefs: Decide capital gains exemptions, heavy-rate exclusions, long-term deduction table and high-value apportionment, producing calc_transfer_tax inputs.
- judge_same_household: Decide whether two people form one household (1세대) for income, acquisition or holding tax purposes.
- count_transfer_homes: Count homes for the one-household-one-home capital gains exemption, applying statutory exclusions automatically.
- judge_temporary_two_homes: Temporary two-home exemption test: one-year gap, disposal deadline, move-in requirement (Income Tax Decree art. 155(1)).
- judge_155_special: Special one-home cases: marriage, caring for parents, inherited home, rural home (Income Tax Decree art. 155).
- count_heavy_homes: Count homes for heavy capital gains rates, excluding low-value provincial homes and other statutory exclusions.
- judge_jongbu_one_home_status: Comprehensive holding tax: is the owner deemed a one-household-one-home holder (attached land, temporary, inherited, cheap provincial home).
- judge_inherited_house_priority: When a decedent held several homes, pick the single inherited home that gets the special treatment.
- judge_co_inherited_owner: Attribute a co-inherited home to one heir under Income Tax Decree art. 155(3).
- judge_reconstruction_membership_transfer: Can a redevelopment/reconstruction association membership be transferred in a speculation zone (Urban Renewal Act art. 39).
- judge_exemption_requirements: Full one-household-one-home capital gains exemption test: holding, residence, price cap, adjusted area.
- judge_rental_income_tax: Residential rental income tax: taxable, home count, deemed rent, separate vs global taxation.
- judge_business_dealer_status: Is the seller a real estate dealer (business income) or an individual (capital gains).
- judge_transfer_reduction_limit: Capital gains relief gate: disqualification, annual and five-year relief caps, choose-one rules (Restriction of Special Taxation Act art. 129/133/127).
- judge_small_house_rental_reduction: Small-home landlord income tax reduction (Special Taxation Act art. 96): eligibility and rate.
- judge_farmland_reduction: Self-cultivated farmland capital gains exemption after 8 years (Special Taxation Act art. 69).
- judge_farmland_daeto: Farmland substitution exemption (Special Taxation Act art. 70): distance, period, area and value ratios.
- judge_second_home_exclusion: Homes excluded from the home count: rural/hometown house, depopulation-area house, unsold completed house.
- judge_first_home_acquisition_relief: First-time home buyer acquisition tax relief (Local Tax Special Act art. 36-3).
- judge_family_loan: Family loan vs gift screening: 4.6% benchmark rate and the 10 million won threshold (Inheritance and Gift Tax Act art. 41-4).
- judge_fund_plan_requirement: Whether a home purchase must file a funding plan and supporting documents.
- judge_adjusted_area_at_date: Was a location an adjusted (regulated) area on a given date, from the designation history.
- judge_156_3_special: Home plus pre-sale right (분양권) one-home special case (Income Tax Decree art. 156-3).
- judge_156_3_from_portfolio: Same as judge_156_3_special, but counts homes from a holdings list.
- screen_relief_candidates: List the tax reliefs and special cases worth checking for a given situation, to avoid omissions.
- get_relief_catalog_entry: Look up one relief catalog entry by statute reference.
- format_consultation_report: Format a consultation result as a report: conclusion, grounds mapped to sources, tailored Q&A.
- format_consultation_output: Standard output formatter for a consultation result.

## How to use

- Call judge_* tools first to settle facts (household, home count, exemption eligibility), then calc_* for amounts.
- Amount tools take `year`; rates are read from a verified parameter table. Unverified years are refused.
- search_law / get_law_detail / search_tax_rulings / get_local_tax_ordinances need the LAW_OC env var (free key from law.go.kr).
